finite_domain.each: all 2^n low source masks, all compact u/t values, all projected target values including the top spill bit; arbitrary b proved by swap cancellation and sampled separately

method: Independent modular integer model plus byte-exact production interpreter; distinguish counterexample, sufficient theorem and finite evidence.
protected_invariant: Preserve x,u,t,b and every unselected y bit; toggle all selected y bits exactly; keep the good set invariant under the ideal map.
failure_modes: Guarding only the first call misses control bits enabled by source load.
Checking only y can miss dirty-t corruption.
Ignoring internal u-load carries gives wrong toggles.
Confusing final outgoing wide/compact carries with internal carries.
